# nexus package

Verbs: get, update, install, remove

## Usage

```
nexus package [flags]
```

## Flags

```
  -h, --help   help for package
```

## Global flags

```
      --host string   target hosts: configured names, comma-separated, or all (default: NEXUS_HOST, then the default host)
      --verbose       log each request and response status to stderr
```

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`nexus package get`](nexus_package_get.md) | List installed packages, or with NAME, get a package |
| [`nexus package install`](nexus_package_install.md) | Install packages |
| [`nexus package remove`](nexus_package_remove.md) | Remove packages |
| [`nexus package update`](nexus_package_update.md) | Upgrade packages |
